tweet.text:
BREAKING: Iran directly rejects reports it is close to a deal with US, saying zero progress has been made on reaching an agreement, and no concessions were made on the nuclear issue.

Oil prices crashed more than 5% today on false claims of a US-Iran deal, after dropping 8% yesterday on the same false claims.

Iran says the US response was "not convincing," and the US "must fully and explicitly address Iran's seven conditions and act upon them; only in this case will the Strait of Hormuz be reopened."
